name: Hamor
title: Hivite chief of Shechem
summary: Hamor was a Hivite chief and ruler of the city of Shechem during Jacob's time. He is best known for the incident where his son Shechem raped Dinah, Jacob's daughter, and the subsequent tragedy in which Simeon and Levi killed the men of the city as revenge. Hamor tried to negotiate a marriage between his son and Dinah but was himself killed in the massacre.

keyEvents.title: Shechem's rape of Dinah
keyEvents.description: Hamor's son Shechem raped Dinah, Jacob's daughter, and seized her by force. Then he fell in love with her and wanted to marry her.

keyEvents.title: Hamor negotiates with Jacob
keyEvents.description: Hamor went to Jacob to negotiate a marriage between Shechem and Dinah, proposing that the two groups intermarry and live together.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's sons set the condition of circumcision
keyEvents.description: Jacob's sons answered Hamor and Shechem with deceit and demanded that all the men in the city be circumcised before they could accept the marriage.

keyEvents.title: Hamor persuades the men of the city
keyEvents.description: Hamor and Shechem persuaded the men of the city to undergo circumcision, promising that Jacob's wealth and property would become theirs.

keyEvents.title: The massacre at Shechem
keyEvents.description: On the third day, while the men were weak from pain after their circumcision, Simeon and Levi attacked the city and killed all the men, including Hamor and his son Shechem.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's land purchase mentioned in the New Testament
keyEvents.description: Acts refers to the burial place that Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem, where Joseph's bones were later buried.
